{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p = 'specs/001-transactions/spec.md'
s = open(p).read()

# 4) Insert FR-014..FR-021 after FR-013, before '### Key Entities'
fr_anchor = '''- **FR-013** (preservation): All existing public `cachetools` APIs MUST retain
  their current behavior; the new cache MUST be built on the existing
  `cachetools.LRUCache` for bounded storage; upstream tests MUST remain
  unchanged and passing.
'''
new_frs = fr_anchor + '''- **FR-014** (R04): `invalidate_many(tags, mode='any')` MUST remove the union
  of live entries carrying any of the supplied tags when `mode='any'`, and
  only live entries carrying every supplied tag when `mode='all'`; it MUST
  return the number of distinct removed keys.
- **FR-015** (R04): An empty requested tag set MUST remove zero entries in
  either mode (in particular, an empty `'all'` request MUST NOT match every
  key) and MUST return `0`.
- **FR-016** (R04): `invalidate_many` MUST reject an invalid `mode` (anything
  other than `'any'` or `'all'`) and invalid tags (bare string, non-string
  entries) with `ValueError` BEFORE any mutation; `invalidate(tag)` MUST
  remain compatible (same semantics as `invalidate_many([tag], mode='any')`).
- **FR-017** (R05): `resize(maxsize)` MUST validate its argument first as a
  positive integer excluding `bool` (else `ValueError`); shrinking MUST evict
  least-recently-used entries until the live count equals the new capacity
  while preserving surviving entries' relative LRU order; growing MUST not
  evict; a failed resize MUST preserve all state (capacity, entries, tags,
  recency).
- **FR-018** (R05): The `maxsize` property MUST report the cache's current
  capacity (initial value from construction; updated by successful `resize`).
- **FR-019** (R05 clarification, Claim-A round 2, 2026-09-22): Preserving a
  surviving entry across `resize` MUST preserve its absolute expiry (R07/R08
  define the expiry as entry state); a resize that drops expiries (making
  entries immortal) or recomputes them from the resize time MUST NOT be
  accepted as satisfying R05. Expiry itself is out of scope until R07/R08 are
  added; this clause constrains any future expiry state.
- **FR-020** (R06): Tags MUST be accepted as any finite iterable, including
  generators, and MUST be consumed exactly once; the cache MUST store only the
  materialized (deduplicated) tag set, never the original iterable.
- **FR-021** (R06): Returned values MUST remain detached across repeated
  `get`s and `put`s, including nested lists and dicts; no returned object
  (or object nested within one) may alias the stored value or any other
  returned object.
'''
assert fr_anchor in s
s = s.replace(fr_anchor, new_frs, 1)

# 5) Update Success Criteria: replace SC-001..SC-005 block tail with extended set
sc_anchor = '''- **SC-004**: After any sequence of at least 1000 mixed operations (put,
  replace, get, invalidate, eviction) on a small cache, `len` equals the live
  entry count, never exceeds `maxsize`, and no evicted key's old tags affect a
  later re-put of that key (0 stale memberships).
- **SC-005**: Retrieval isolation: mutating either the input object or a
  returned object never changes the stored value (verified for nested
  container values, not only scalars).'''
new_sc = sc_anchor + '''
- **SC-006**: `invalidate_many` removes exactly the entries described by the
  requested tag set and mode in 100% of test cases (union for `'any'`,
  intersection for `'all'`), returns the exact distinct removed-key count,
  removes zero entries for empty requests in both modes, and leaves state
  unchanged for 100% of invalid mode/tag inputs.
- **SC-007**: `resize` succeeds for 100% of valid positive non-bool integer
  capacities: shrinking evicts exactly the least-recently-used entries (no
  other evictions), growing evicts none, surviving LRU order is preserved in
  100% of cases, the `maxsize` property always reports the current capacity,
  and 100% of invalid inputs (bool, zero, negative, float, non-numeric) leave
  all state unchanged.
- **SC-008**: A generator passed as tags is consumed exactly once in 100% of
  cases (verified with an instrumented generator), and repeated `get`/`put`
  cycles (>= 10 per key) produce 100% detached copies for nested list/dict
  values (mutation of any returned object never changes stored state).'''
assert sc_anchor in s
s = s.replace(sc_anchor, new_sc, 1)

# 6) Update A7 (bulk invalidation no longer out of scope) and add A9-A11
a7_old = '''- **A7**: `invalidate` accepts a single tag (string); bulk/multi-tag
  invalidation is out of scope for this milestone.'''
a7_new = '''- **A7**: `invalidate` accepts a single tag (string) and remains compatible
  with `invalidate_many([tag], mode='any')`; bulk/multi-tag invalidation is
  provided by `invalidate_many` (R04).''' 
assert a7_old in s
s = s.replace(a7_old, a7_new, 1)

a8_anchor = '''- **A8**: The Claim-A candidate extension is treated as an active requirement
  (FR-010) per the milestone input; the variant label
  `put_no_recency_refresh` is noted for traceability only and does NOT
  override FR-010 (i.e., recency refresh on overwrite IS required).'''
a8_new = a8_anchor + '''
- **A9**: The conflicting old design note ('empty all-tags matches every key
  and resizing may flush the cache') is superseded by R04/R05 and MUST NOT be
  relied upon; specifically, empty requested tags remove zero entries and
  resizing never flushes the cache.
- **A10**: The R05 round-2 clarification (absolute-expiry preservation) is
  recorded as FR-019 and is binding for any implementation that introduces
  expiry state (R07/R08); since the current milestone input defines no expiry
  behavior, no expiry is implemented or tested in this milestone.
- **A11**: `invalidate_many` deduplicates the requested tag set for matching
  (duplicates in the request do not change the match set or the returned
count); the returned count is always the number of distinct removed keys.'''
assert a8_anchor in s
s = s.replace(a8_anchor, a8_new, 1)

# 7) Status line + append traceability section
s = s.replace('**Status**: Draft', '**Status**: Draft (updated 2026-10-17 for milestone 2 + round-2 clarification)', 1)
trace = '''
## Requirement Traceability

| Milestone input | Spec requirement(s) | Notes |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------|
| R01 | FR-002, FR-003, FR-004 | put/get/copying/tags |
| R02 | FR-005, FR-006, FR-007, FR-008, FR-009 | invalidate, replace, eviction, recency, len |
| R02 extension (Claim-A, 2026-09-21) | FR-010 | recency refresh on overwrite (A8) |
| R03 | FR-001, FR-011, FR-012 | maxsize validation, atomic replacement, one slot per value |
| Preservation | FR-013 | existing APIs unchanged; built on LRUCache |
| R04 (milestone 2) | FR-014, FR-015, FR-016 | invalidate_many any/all, empty=zero, fail-fast |
| R05 (milestone 2) | FR-017, FR-018 | resize validation, LRU shrink, grow, maxsize property |
| R05 clarification (round 2, 2026-09-22) | FR-019 | absolute-expiry preservation (binding when R07/R08 land; A10) |
| R06 (milestone 2) | FR-020, FR-021 | generator tags consumed once; repeated detachment |
| Conflicting design note | A9 | superseded by R04/R05; MUST NOT be relied upon |
'''
if '## Requirement Traceability' not in s:
    s = s.rstrip() + '\n' + trace

open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('part2 ok, len', len(s))
PYEOF"}
